description: Default theme for the Deep Stellar Coalition. Set during the Old Republic era — Republic vs Sith Empire and neutral factions.
author: Deep Stellar Coalition

1.label: Tier I
1.description: Entry level commanders. Limited EMS pool. Small ships and basic ground forces only.

2.label: Tier II
2.description: Experienced officers. Medium EMS pool. Mid-range ships and advanced ground forces.

3.label: Tier III
3.description: Command level. Full EMS pool. All ships and ground forces unlocked.

battle_sizes.name: Brawl
battle_sizes.flavor: A skirmish between small forces. Quick and brutal.

battle_sizes.name: Firefight
battle_sizes.flavor: A tactical engagement between organized units.

battle_sizes.name: Skirmish
battle_sizes.flavor: A mid-scale battle with real strategic stakes.

battle_sizes.name: Engagement
battle_sizes.flavor: A full engagement between major forces.

battle_sizes.name: Battleground
battle_sizes.flavor: A decisive battle that shapes the fate of the campaign.

tactics.name: Cautious
tactics.description: No risk, no reward. Play it safe.

tactics.name: Aggressive
tactics.description: Push hard. Meaningful advantage with manageable risk.

tactics.name: Risky
tactics.description: All or nothing. Maximum bonus but dangerous in an even fight.

combat.label: Combat
combat.description: Firepower and Hull dominant. Built for direct engagement and sustained punishment.

carrier.label: Carrier
carrier.description: Capacity dominant. Deploys fighter wings and support craft. Overwhelms through numbers and flexibility.

picket.label: Picket
picket.description: Speed and Agility dominant. Fast, evasive, and lethal against Carriers. Struggles against raw firepower.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Even spread across all attributes. No catastrophic losses, no dominant wins. The calculated hedge.

space_matchups.flavor: Focused firepower overwhelms a generalist fleet.
Fighter swarms pick apart a combat fleet before it can engage.
Raw firepower shreds fast ships that get too close.
Fighter wings provide flexible pressure a generalist fleet struggles to counter.
Endless fighter waves overwhelm even the heaviest combat vessels.
Fast picket ships intercept and destroy fighter wings before they deploy.
Speed and evasion frustrate a generalist fleet.
Combat ships absorb picket fire and return devastating salvos.
Picket ships tear through carrier screens before fighters can launch.
Two generalist fleets — tactics and commanders decide the outcome.

space_ships.name: Starfighter Squadron
space_ships.description: 10 mainline combat strike craft. Individually fragile, collectively lethal.
space_ships.note: Minimum viable swarm unit. 75 squadrons = 750 EMS = one Super Dreadnought.

space_ships.name: Elite Starfighter Squadron
space_ships.description: 10 elite combat strike craft. Better pilots, better ships, exponentially more dangerous.
space_ships.note: 2x base cost. Same count, exponentially higher threat.

space_ships.name: Legendary Starfighter Squadron
space_ships.description: 10 legendary pilots. The best in the galaxy. Near capital ship threat at fighter speed.
space_ships.note: 3x base cost. Vader's wing level. Tier 2 minimum.

space_ships.name: Corvette
space_ships.description: Light mainline combat warship 100-200m. Fast hit-and-run. Individually fragile, dangerous in numbers.
space_ships.note: Fast asset. Commits to Picket ratio.

space_ships.name: Frigate
space_ships.description: Medium combat vessel 200-300m. Versatile and multirole. The workhorse of any fleet.
space_ships.note: True generalist. Contributes to Balanced ratio.

space_ships.name: Light Cruiser
space_ships.description: Heavier warship 300-400m. Supports larger vessels. Perfectly even attribute spread.

space_ships.name: Escort Carrier
space_ships.description: Light economic carrier vessel. Primarily designed to host starfighters. Capacity over firepower.
space_ships.note: Entry level Carrier type. High capacity, vulnerable without escort.

space_ships.name: Heavy Cruiser
space_ships.description: Larger warship 400-600m. Backbone of most fleets. Firepower and Hull dominant.
space_ships.note: Same cost as Escort Carrier, completely different role. Combat backbone.

space_ships.name: Battlecruiser
space_ships.description: Heavy capital ship 600-700m. Speed and firepower over durability. The aggressive option.
space_ships.note: First true capital ship. Tier 2 cornerstone.

space_ships.name: Battleship
space_ships.description: Heavy mainline capital ship. Large gun batteries. Built to absorb and deliver punishment.
space_ships.note: Peak Tier 2 combat ship. Slow, devastating, hard to kill.

space_ships.name: Fleet Carrier
space_ships.description: Heavy starfighter carrier. Centerpiece of a Carrier fleet. Maximum capacity.
space_ships.note: Same cost as Battleship. Maximum capacity score. Needs escort to survive.

space_ships.name: Dreadnought
space_ships.description: Large command vessel 5000m+. Heavy gun batteries. Orbital bombardment capable.
space_ships.note: First Tier 3 ship. Losing this is a campaign event.

space_ships.name: Heavy Dreadnought
space_ships.description: Imposing capital class. Maximum firepower and hull. Near indestructible gun platform.
space_ships.note: Near maximum everything except speed and capacity. 500 EMS commitment.

space_ships.name: Super Dreadnought
space_ships.description: 6-7km mobile fortress and fleet command vessel. Carries entire armies. The boss ship.
space_ships.note: Commander declares Combat or Carrier at battle time. Choice is secret until results post. Appearing in a campaign is a narrative event.

infantry.label: Infantry
infantry.description: Fast, mobile, and disciplined. Excels against Heavy Armor through numbers and flanking. Vulnerable to Mechanized forces.

mechanized.label: Mechanized/AI
mechanized.description: Walkers, droids, repulsorlift, and artillery. Range and firepower dominant. Shreds Infantry but vulnerable to Heavy Armor.

heavy_armor.label: Heavy Armor
heavy_armor.description: Tanks and behemoth vehicles. Near indestructible. Destroys Mechanized forces but slow and vulnerable to Infantry flanking.

combined_arms.label: Combined Arms
combined_arms.description: Balanced mix of infantry and armor. No catastrophic losses, no dominant wins. The calculated hedge.

ground_matchups.flavor: Disciplined infantry finds gaps in a mixed force.
Walkers and droids cut through infantry before they can close the distance.
Infantry swarms flank and overwhelm slow heavy armor.
Mechanized firepower and range pressures a generalist force.
Walkers and artillery destroy infantry formations at range.
Heavy armor shrugs off mechanized fire and crushes them.
Raw armor superiority overwhelms a mixed force.
Infantry flanks and swarms heavy armor from all sides.
Heavy armor rolls through mechanized units without slowing.
Two balanced forces — tactics and commanders decide the outcome.

ground_forces.name: Infantry Squad
ground_forces.description: 9 soldiers + 1 squad leader. The atomic unit of ground warfare.

ground_forces.name: Speeder Bike Squad
ground_forces.description: Fast reconnaissance and harassment unit. Maximum mobility, minimal protection.

ground_forces.name: Infantry Platoon
ground_forces.description: 4 squads of soldiers. ~36 troops. First real area control unit.

ground_forces.name: Apprentice / Padawan
ground_forces.description: A Force-sensitive in training. Powerful individual, limited battlefield presence.
ground_forces.note: Commander declares Infantry or Combined Arms at battle time. Tier 1 force user attachment.

ground_forces.name: SpecForce Squad
ground_forces.description: Elite special operations unit. High morale, sniper capability, precision strikes.

ground_forces.name: Light Tank / Walker Platoon
ground_forces.description: Light armored vehicles. Support role. Bridges infantry and heavy armor.

ground_forces.name: Lord / Knight
ground_forces.description: A trained Force user of significant power. Fearsome on the battlefield.
ground_forces.note: Commander declares Infantry or Combined Arms at battle time. Tier 2 force user attachment.

ground_forces.name: Artillery Battery
ground_forces.description: Heavy indirect fire platform. Devastates anything at extreme range. Fragile up close.
ground_forces.note: Range 9 is the differentiator. Capital ship-scale turbolasers. Best unit against anything at range.

ground_forces.name: Medium Tank / Walker Platoon
ground_forces.description: Core armored unit. Solid firepower, solid armor. The backbone of a Heavy Armor force.

ground_forces.name: Darth
ground_forces.description: A Sith Lord of immense power. The most dangerous individual on any battlefield. A boss fight.
ground_forces.note: Commander declares ANY type at battle time. Choice is secret until results post. Maximum one per army. Tier 3 only.

ground_forces.name: Heavy Tank / Walker Platoon
ground_forces.description: Massive armored vehicles. Near indestructible. Slow but devastating.

ground_forces.name: Close-Air-Support Patrol
ground_forces.description: Atmospheric gunships providing direct air support. Fast, flexible, high range.
ground_forces.note: Same cost as Heavy Tank. Completely different role. Speed and range vs raw armor.

ground_forces.name: Infantry Company
ground_forces.description: 4 platoons. ~144 soldiers. Serious area control and sustained presence.

ground_forces.name: Behemoth Vehicle
ground_forces.description: Massive exotic war machine. Maximum armor. Terrifying psychological impact.
ground_forces.note: Losing this is a campaign event. Maximum armor score.

ground_forces.name: Infantry Battalion
ground_forces.description: 4 companies. ~576 soldiers. The largest deployable infantry force. Maximum area control.
ground_forces.note: Same raw score as Behemoth. Completely different. Numbers vs individual power.

force_user_rules.description: Force users are tier-gated attachments to any army. They contribute EMS to their declared type.
rules: You cannot field a Force user equal to or above your own rank tier.
Force user type choice is locked at battle declaration and secret until results post.
Force user EMS counts toward the ratio of their declared type.
